name: serialization-contract-enumerated-named-and-index-parameter
description: A TypeScript parameter typed as an object type that names properties beside a string index signature holds every other member of the value it is given under that signature, so a function that hands such a parameter to one that enumerates it reads every property of each value passed to it, the members its type does not name included; a parameter of that type read only by a literal key holds back nothing.
